label_policy: Frozen before M2.1D live evaluation. expected_outcome is answer, refusal, or premise_denial. Full credit requires every expected fact and semantic source support; exact citation is reported separately.

cases.question: NBA 比赛开始时如何将球投入比赛？
expected_facts: the ball is put into play at the start of the game by a jump ball in the center circle

cases.question: What happens when the shot clock reads 0 during an offensive possession?
expected_facts: a shot clock violation has occurred

cases.question: NBA 规则如何定义罚球？
expected_facts: a free throw is a one-point unhindered attempt from behind the free throw line

cases.question: What may a thrower-in not do before releasing the ball?
expected_facts: the thrower-in may not carry the ball onto the court or fail to release it within five seconds

cases.question: 比赛恢复时，端线发球后比赛计时何时开始？
expected_facts: the game clock starts when the ball is legally touched by a player on the court

cases.question: 进攻三秒违例后，球将在哪里交给对方球队？
expected_facts: the opposing team receives the ball on the nearest sideline at the free throw line extended

cases.question: 在罚球中双方都违例时，规则如何处理跳球？
expected_facts: a jump ball is administered at midcourt between two opponents in the game

cases.question: When may a substitution be made during the last two minutes of a period?
expected_facts: a reasonable amount of time is allowed for a substitution

cases.question: NBA 球队在后场连续控制球最多多少秒？
expected_facts: a team may not continuously possess the ball in its backcourt for more than eight seconds

cases.question: How is a transition scoring opportunity described in the rulebook?
expected_facts: it exists after a change in possession when the offensive team continuously advances with a speed or defender-position advantage

cases.question: NBA 术语表如何定义 True Shooting Percentage？
expected_facts: a shooting percentage that factors in three-point field goals and free throws

cases.question: What does Turnover Ratio measure?
expected_facts: turnovers averaged per 100 possessions used

cases.question: Wins 在 NBA 术语表中表示什么？
expected_facts: the number of games won by a player or team

cases.question: How is Win Percentage calculated?
expected_facts: wins divided by games played

cases.question: 三双统计需要满足什么条件？
expected_facts: double-digit totals in three of five categories in a game

cases.question: What does Usage Percentage represent?
expected_facts: the percentage of team plays used by a player while on the floor

cases.question: Score Frequency 衡量什么？
expected_facts: the percentage of plays where a player or team scores at least one point

cases.question: How are Points Per Possession defined?
expected_facts: the number of points a player or team scores per possession

cases.question: NBA 术语表中的 PIE 衡量什么？
expected_facts: a player's overall statistical contribution against total statistics in games played

cases.question: What does the glossary mean by percentile?
expected_facts: a player's or team's points per possession ranked against the rest of the league

cases.question: Which named player must take every transition take-foul free throw?
expected_facts: the rule does not require a fixed named player
